title: Skill Definition
summary: Main skill execution flow. Generates manual test design artifacts from specifications: observations, risks, priorities, test cases, effort estimates, gate decisions, Go/No-Go brief. References artifact-contract.md for I/O schema, case-design-policy.md for test design principles, risk-and-gate-policy.md for classification. Uses goldens/ as review anchors. Supports mobile platform pack and domain packs (EC, finance, SaaS RBAC). 型付き技法・被覆検証・非破壊移行はtechnique-coverage.mdを参照。 compact生成、予算・usage、証跡版の契約はefficient-generation.mdを参照。 要件定義信頼度・要確認集計・根拠付き再評価はrequirements-confidence.mdとspec-07を参照。
risks: Output quality depends on input specification completeness
